title: Sudden bathroom pipe burst
description: A pipe suddenly burst in the upstairs bathroom and water damaged the ceiling and wooden floor below.
expected_behavior: Positive water clause, but missing plumber report and estimate should keep the claim in human review.

title: Long-term leaking pipe
description: A slow leak behind the bathroom wall continued for several months and caused rot and mould.
expected_behavior: Gradual leakage and rot exclusions should produce likely not covered or human review.

title: Theft excluded by essential policy
description: Someone broke into my home and stole my laptop and camera.
expected_behavior: Exact not-covered wording must never become covered.

title: Kitchen fire damage
description: A pan caught fire in the kitchen and smoke damaged the cabinets and painted walls.
expected_behavior: Fire has an exact positive clause; missing evidence can still require review.

title: Forced-entry home theft
description: A burglar forced the rear door of my house and stole a television and jewellery.
expected_behavior: Theft is positively covered, with police report and ownership evidence still required.

title: Bicycle stolen from locked home
description: A burglar forced open the locked basement of my house and stole my bicycle.
expected_behavior: Theft has exact positive wording; police report and proof of ownership remain required.

title: Storm-damaged roof
description: A severe wind storm removed roof tiles and rain entered the attic during the same night.
expected_behavior: Storm has positive wording; photos, weather evidence, and estimate remain relevant.

title: Accidental fixed-window breakage
description: During cleaning, a step stool slipped and accidentally shattered the fixed living-room window glass.
expected_behavior: Fixed glass has an exact positive clause.

title: Rear bumper collision
description: Another car hit my vehicle at low speed and cracked the rear bumper and tail light.
expected_behavior: Collision is positively covered, subject to the evidence checklist.

title: Vehicle stolen from driveway
description: My locked car was stolen from the driveway overnight and I reported it to the police.
expected_behavior: Vehicle theft is positively covered, with keys and ownership evidence still required.

title: Hail dents
description: A hailstorm left dozens of dents across the roof and bonnet of my parked car.
expected_behavior: This stresses cross-domain classification because hail can map to storm or vehicle damage; uncertainty should not be auto-approved.

title: Sudden illness abroad
description: I developed a sudden high fever while abroad and needed emergency hospital treatment.
expected_behavior: Emergency medical treatment has positive wording; medical report and receipts are required.

title: Pre-existing medical condition
description: I needed treatment abroad for a medical condition diagnosed several months before the trip.
expected_behavior: Pre-existing-condition wording should produce exclusion risk or human review.

title: Airline lost checked baggage
description: The airline lost my checked suitcase and issued a baggage irregularity report.
expected_behavior: Carrier baggage loss is positively covered, subject to the required documents.

title: Conditional trip cancellation
description: I cancelled my holiday before departure because my travelling companion suffered an unexpected family bereavement.
expected_behavior: Conditional cancellation wording plus explicit non-covered reasons should fail closed to not covered or human review.

title: Directly conflicting theft clauses
description: Someone broke into the insured house and stole a computer.
expected_behavior: Contradictory positive and negative clauses must produce unclear and human review.

title: Conditional storm wording
description: Strong wind damaged the roof and rain entered the attic.
expected_behavior: May-be-covered wording should remain conditional and require review.

title: Ambiguous water reference
description: A washing-machine hose leaked suddenly and damaged the kitchen floor.
expected_behavior: A topic reference without operative coverage wording must fail closed to unclear.
